public.text: The criterion that DPI-H components should be “non-transactional” conflicts with components such as the Computable Decision Support Engine, HMIS, Public Health Surveillance Platform, and possibly the Lifelong Health Record, all of which may process operational transactions.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace “non-transactional” with: “not primarily responsible for local point-of-service workflow or programme-specific transaction processing.” Assess every proposed component against the revised criterion.
